headline: Nvidia Shares Jump 33% as Jensen Huang Returns as CEO
summary: Nvidia reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as president and chief executive, less than two weeks after his resignation. The board said it received input from senior US government officials before approving the return.
why: Nvidia designs graphics processors and AI accelerators that are central to data-center spending, so leadership changes at the company are closely watched by investors.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The stock rose sharply after the board reinstated Huang as CEO.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The board reinstated Huang as CEO after a short gap following his resignation, with the board citing his candor and ability to lead the company.
